$comment: Ship criteria for <name>, checked by evaluate.py against the latest run.
Set these BEFORE changing a prompt or swapping a model, and commit them.
Deciding what counts as good enough after seeing the number is how a
regression ships with a rationalisation attached.
tool_precision matters as much as pass rate: an agent that reaches the
right answer by calling four tools when one would do is slower, more
expensive, and more likely to go wrong on the next input.

thresholds.note: fraction of cases meeting every expectation
expected tool calls / actual tool calls — catches flailing
mean graph steps per case; rising steps means rising cost
